description.zh: 授权共享镜像的阿里云账号ID列表。列表最多10个元素。
description.en: The list of Alibaba Cloud account IDs for authorization of the shared image. The list can contain up to 10 elements.

description.zh: 自定义镜像的描述信息。能包含2~256个字符。不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。默认值：空，表示保持原有描述信息不变。
description.en: The description of the custom image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. Default value: null, which indicates that the original description is retained.

description.zh: 自定义镜像的名称。包含2~128个字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。默认值：空，表示保持原有名称不变。
description.en: The name of the custom image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. Default value: null, which indicates that the original name is retained.

description.zh: 删除镜像共享的阿里云账号ID列表。列表最多10个元素。
description.en: The list of Alibaba Cloud account IDs from which you want to remove the image sharing permissions. The list can contain up to 10 elements.

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：
- 您只能共享自己的自定义镜像给其他阿里云用户。
- 每份自定义镜像一次最多共享给10个阿里云账号。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, take note of the following items:
- You can share only your own custom images with other Alibaba Cloud accounts.
- Each custom image can be shared with up to 10 Alibaba Cloud accounts at a time.
